verdict.rationale: Pulumi ships Neo, a first-party in-product infrastructure agent that 'provisions, governs, and optimizes' cloud infrastructure and 'monitors outcomes' (pulumi-docs-9, pulumi-docs-20). Pulumi Agents are also documented to investigate incidents and maintain infrastructure (pulumi-docs-64, pulumi-docs-67), which implies AI analysis of the user's own infrastructure data. The evidence describes Neo mainly as executing plain-English requests, though, rather than surfacing insights or suggestions from the user's data. The MCP server serves external assistants, so it does not count as an in-product capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-generated insights or recommendations surfaced inside Pulumi Cloud, concrete examples of the analysis output (e.g., optimization or cost suggestions), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
